name: field-finance-payouts
objective: Re-prove field wallet/ledger/commission/payout isolation and unknown-result reconciliation while WLT remains financial truth.
truthOwner: WLT is sole financial truth; DSH/app-field expose only field-scoped representative finance through authenticated context.

tasks.objective: Re-prove field finance isolation and payout reconciliation while preserving WLT as the single financial truth.
tasks.currentProblem: Historical finance evidence is not candidate-bound and current shared finance logic has not been proven end to end on BB.
tasks.requiredChange: Execute positive/negative field finance and payout scenarios; repair only reproduced WLT/DSH boundary defects and add regression coverage.
tasks.targetState: A field actor sees only authorized finance context; payout create/retry is idempotent, unknown outcomes reconcile from server truth and operator capabilities remain separated.
tasks.action: Test own/wrong worker-store reads, commissions, payout destination/request, timeout/unknown result, retry/restart and operator readback against current WLT/DSH contracts.
mustNotChange: Do not copy WLT balances into DSH/mobile truth.
Do not broaden to unrelated settlement/accounting.
Do not allow client actor scope to override server identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Own finance data is correct and wrong actor/store is denied.
Payout retry preserves one intent/idempotency identity.
Unknown result reconciles before a new request.
Restart preserves recoverable attempt state and operator readback remains permission-scoped.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix financial integrity; never roll back by weakening isolation/idempotency or duplicating WLT truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused field-finance boundary commit only if current verification reproduces a defect.
